title: Three People Handshaking, 1970s Vintage B&W Photograph, Dee Anna
description: A 1970s black and white photograph featuring a woman in the center shaking hands with a man on her right while another man with a mustache and plaid shirt stands beside her on the left. The group is posed indoors under a wooden beam ceiling structure, exhibiting classic 1970s hairstyles and attire. The back is inscribed with the name 'Dee Anna' in blue cursive pen.
